message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate crime(s) from list based on facts.

Facts: Defendant Wang2 bribed a public official (the health bureau director) cash 20,000 RMB to seek job promotion (position adjustment). This is bribery. The list includes:

- 行贿 (bribery) – giving bribe to public officials.
- 受贿 (receiving bribe) – for officials.
- 利用影响力受贿 – using influence to receive bribe.
- 对单位行贿 – bribery of unit.
- 对非国家工作人员行贿 – bribery of non-state staff.
- 对单位受贿 – unit receiving bribe.
- 单位行贿 – unit bribery.
- 单位受贿 – unit receiving bribe.
- 行贿 – correct.

Thus the crime is 行贿 (bribery). Also maybe "受贿" is for the official, not the defendant. So only 行贿.

Thus answer: [罪名]行贿<eoa>
